name: rio
tagline: GPU-accelerated terminal emulator for desktop and browser
description: rio is a GPU-accelerated terminal emulator that runs both on the desktop and in the browser. It focuses on performance and a modern look, using the GPU for rendering to keep output smooth even with heavy workloads. It is built in Rust and was one of the trending Rust projects of the week, appealing to developers who want a fast, polished terminal with a clean codebase.
highlights: GPU-accelerated rendering for smooth terminal output
Runs on both desktop and in the browser
Modern, performant design built in Rust
One of the trending Rust projects of the week
curatorNote: Terminal emulators are a crowded space, but rio's GPU rendering and browser support set it apart. A genuinely fast, modern option for developers who live in the terminal.
